chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the eunuchs and the aged women, is the Tawaaf of the women upon them? He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes, the Tawaaf is upon all of them.'

key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: Tawaaf Al-Nisaa (the specific circumambulation ritual for women)

ai.seo_question: Do eunuchs and elderly women have to perform Tawaaf Al-Nisaa?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the fiqh of gender-specific rituals by confirming that eunuchs (*alkhisaan*) and elderly women must perform *Tawaaf Al-Nisaa*, the circumambulation pattern distinct from men's. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly view that the obligation is tied to the category of 'women' for ritual purposes, regardless of age or the specific nature of their physical characteristics, ensuring uniformity in the performance of Hajj rites.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yaqteen, from his brother Al Husayn Bin Ali Bin Yaqteen who said,
‘I asked Abu Al-Hassanasws about the eunuchs and the aged women, is there Tawaaf Al-Nisaa upon them?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, upon them is the Tawaaf (Al-Nisaa), all of them’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin who has said the following:
“I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the castrated people and old women if Tawaf al- Nisa’ is obligatory upon them. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, it is obligatory on all of them.’”
